action.description: Action in the exact type and economic units specified in the mechanics.

constraint_violation.description: Sum of stated policy deficits in their declared units; zero does not erase prior costs.

diagnostics.description: Ordered typed array as defined in the objective document; retain nested eligibility vector if applicable.

objective.description: Minimized stated objective for this action; includes specified policy penalties.

state_round.description: Integer identifier of the current book round.

transaction_cost.description: Immediate economic transaction or evidence cost in cash units.

content.prompt: Choose and submit the economically optimal executable action using the received book, current terms, and stated decision criterion. Recompute from actual preceding execution rather than assuming a reference trajectory. Return the complete typed answer and cite the governing mechanics, objective, and current round snapshot. Report a nonzero policy deficit when the optimum cannot remove it; never invent a feasible action or hidden future event.
content.required_final_keys_note: Include all four top-level keys: question_id, integer turn, answers and evidence, even for single-turn cases. Replace every placeholder; this template contains no financial answer.

response_contract.evidence: For each field, a list of IDs of viewed supporting documents. Each field must have its own sufficient support; references elsewhere do not carry over. Valid alternative sufficient routes and relevant corroboration accepted. Numeric tolerance1e-6 absolute+1e-8 relative.

sources.text: Action is [verb,quantity], verb WAIT,CANCEL,BUY or SELL. WAIT/CANCEL quantity is zero. BUY/SELL quantity is an integer one through ten. No new order or sale while an earlier buy is live. SELL cannot exceed confirmed inventory; proceeds less the fee are unsettled pending cash until next round. BUY pays fee 2 immediately and reserves quantity*buy_price; after this reservation cash must be at least 150. A cancellation request leaves the buy live until next-round acknowledgement, and up to two additional lots can fill first. A second cancellation while pending is rejected. Live buys that are not cancelled can fill on advance. Trade corrections and target revisions, when received, affect the actual book. Do not presume an unreceived correction. Integer quantities may be encoded as JSON integers or finite exactly integral JSON numbers (for example 3 and 3.0 are equivalent); booleans and fractional quantities are invalid. This quantity convention does not relax the integer response turn identifier. A rejected action does not execute a default or substitute action and does not change assets or cash. The submission still consumes the current round and the simulation then processes its normal inter-round events.
sources.title: Execution and evidence rules

sources.text: Minimize 10*worst_target_deviation + current fee + 0.1*remaining live quantity + 1000*reserve_shortfall. In every round, any remaining live buy creates a projected confirmed inventory range from inventory after the proposed action to that inventory plus live buy quantity, or plus min(2,live) if cancellation is pending. This includes a preexisting live order in the final round. Worst deviation is the max absolute difference of these two endpoints from the target. In the last round new buys fill immediately; sales still create pending proceeds. A final-round cancellation of a preexisting live order remains pending: there is no subsequent advance or cancellation acknowledgement, so a terminal requirement for no live orders may be unattainable from that book. Diagnostic array is [cash minus full remaining live-buy commitments,worst target deviation,pending sale proceeds]. Reserve shortfall is max(0,150-cash_after_full_commitments). Pending cash cannot fund buys. BUY reserves but does not spend principal until fill; SELL fee is netted from pending proceeds. The supplied current book is authoritative after all received fills, acknowledgements, settlements, or corrections.
sources.title: Decision criterion and measurement convention

sources.text: The current_state and current_terms supplied with round 1 are the authoritative snapshot after received events. They include actual consequences of preceding submitted actions. Use those balances, observations, and current contractual terms; do not replace them with a canonical or assumed path. Earlier estimates may have been superseded. No later snapshot is available yet.
